{{Top|leg}}
The '''Iith'lon''' were a [[Kian'thar]] political faction, also known as the '''Preservers''', for they spoke of keeping to the traditional ways of their ancestors and remaining separated from the galactic community. This kept them at odds with the [[Lllun]] faction.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
